images.prompt: Create ONE finished 16:9 landscape image that is a strange dream picture painted by a young woman in an ancient Chinese historical drama. Do not copy the modern sports jersey. This is a deliberately uncanny cinematic oil-and-ink realist dream, not a collage and not a poster. A vast calm southern Chinese lake at night; a single bright full moon in the upper left and its clearly circular luminous reflection low in the water below, slight authentic ripples. On the lower right, one solitary adult man resembling Faker is seated on a low stone terrace beside a tiny dark wooden table, lifting a small ceramic wine cup and quietly looking at the lake. He wears a plain charcoal ancient scholar robe; modern thin round eyeglasses and recognizable haircut are an intentional dream detail. Long/wide environmental shot: seated person occupies about 30 percent of frame height, shown in readable left three-quarter profile, landscape occupies most of frame. His face must remain plausible and recognizable at this scale, not a large floating portrait. One small ceramic wine jug on the table, no other people, no second face. Moonlight silver blue water, soft mist far away, dark pine silhouettes, muted ivory silk-paper texture in the image surface; lyrical loneliness with sober fine detail, not fantasy glowing VFX. Front-on flat artwork content edge to edge, no frame, no scroll handles, no border, no calligraphy, no text, no logos. Balanced negative space on left lake; physically coherent reflection and hands.

In reference 1, LEFT TO RIGHT are Duke, TheShy, Baolan, JackeyLove, Rookie partly hidden, Ning on the extreme right with glasses. ESSENTIAL new composition: TheShy is unmistakably the central foremost C-position star, occupying x=50 percent, his youthful brown-haired narrow smiling face fully visible above the cup with no eyeglasses. This deliberately REARRANGES the original group photograph; it must not leave TheShy left of center. All SIX distinct teammates are present exactly once, nobody duplicated. Arrange from image LEFT to RIGHT: Duke (outer left slightly rear), Baolan (left inner with glasses), TheShy (front CENTER), Rookie (right inner slightly rear, face visible), JackeyLove (further right), Ning (outer right tall black fringe and glasses). Other teammates lean and gather toward him with genuine victorious smiles; some rest natural arms on adjacent shoulders without tangled hands. Accurate unretouched human faces, period 2018 hairstyles, real black nylon windbreakers, gold piping, blue medal ribbons, cream white undershirts. Full six-person medium-wide group, waist-up with trophy pedestal partly visible, all six heads unobscured. Vast dark esports stadium, blue-white stadium spotlights and gold confetti, white rim light on hair, professional on-location press-photo texture, not illustration, no ancient clothing, no painterly filter. Let small authentic jacket details remain natural; background team symbol may be defocused, no oversized text, no subtitles or watermarks, no fake documentary date stamp. Edge to edge artwork, no frame, no scroll, no collage. This is an AI dream-scene reconstruction, not a claim of an unaltered archival photograph.
